title: Notes on Transversality and Statistical Degeneracies in Distributional Models
summary: These notes provide a pedagogical introduction to the role of transversality theory in the analysis of statistical degeneracies within the framework of distributional statistical models. The classical question of when a statistical model is well-behaved - in the sense of being identifiable, having non-singular Fisher information, and admitting robust estimation - is reformulated as a question about the geometry of a kernel-induced feature map.
